# Re-review findings — chunk-D3-1-fix (`58c11d3`)

**Independent verification summary. All counts cited below were re-derived; nothing taken from the builder's commit message or manifest on faith.**

| Check | What I did | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `git show --numstat -M 58c11d3` | 60 file moves, all `0 0`, plus `0 9` on `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` only. Pure renames. |
| 2 | 3-form scan (bare, no-evidence-prefix, with-evidence-prefix) over LEDGER/tests/tools for all 41 parent basenames | 14 archived entries: 0 hits all forms. The 9 restored entries: each has ≥1 hit. 27 never-moved-with-refs entries: remain flat. Zero entries are both archived AND referenced. |
| 3 | Read `pre-move-sha256.json`+`post-move-verification.json`; checked membership of the 14 archive entries in D2 inventory | None of the 14 archive entries appears in either D2 inventory file. Decision rested on LEDGER/tests/tools only. D2 inventory correctly demoted to cross-check. |
| 4 | Combined `numstat` of `685e379` + `58c11d3` | Only `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` shows `0/0` content delta (29 inserts round 1, 9 deletes round 2). Every other touched row is `0 0`. |
| 5 | `legacy-duplicates/` tree + blob SHA at `4965f1e` vs `58c11d3` | Same file list, all blobs identical. |
| 6 | 10 archive files + 5 restored entries (head 3 each = 15 files) compared via `git ls-tree` blob SHA at `4965f1e` vs `58c11d3` | All 25 OK. |
| 7 | `git diff 4965f1e..58c11d3 | grep default_evidence_dir` and full-repo grep at both endpoints | Zero matches in diff content. Repo-wide matches all in pre-existing, untouched files (planning/, sprint-loop.py, test_sprint_loop.py) and in archived build-evidence payload that was preserved verbatim. |
| 8 | `pytest -q` at HEAD | `241 passed, 3 skipped` — exact match to builder's claim. The 3 named files (`test_evidence_consolidation_d2.py`, `test_sprint_loop.py`, `test_repo_layout.py`) → 90/90 pass. |
| 9 | `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` content vs `git ls-tree archive/` contents | Exactly 14 entries listed; identical set on disk. The 9 removed rows match the 9 restored entries byte-for-byte. Reasons are descriptive, not claim-grade. |
| 10 | Scope escapes | `evidence/phase-4.5/tokens/` unchanged; `evidence/LEDGER.md` unchanged; 0 deletions; HEAD not merged to `origin/main` (HEAD branch is `factory/d3-evidence-hygiene`); exactly 2 commits on top of `4965f1e`; `planning/evidence-hygiene/PLAN.md` present at HEAD. |

## Findings

```
- severity: low
  category: correctness
  section: evidence/LEDGER.md:69
  claim: r-chunk1-spec-v2-20260813-2114 is restored because it has 1 LEDGER
         reference under the bare-name form.
  evidence: My scan shows L=(1,0,0) for this entry — exactly one
            single-line hit on a "BUILDER: BLOCKED ... run=r-chunk1-spec-v2-…"
            attestation row in LEDGER.md:69. Without that single line,
            every other scan form returns zero. Under the brief's explicit
            "all three forms" criterion this is still a hit, so the
            restore is correct. But the entire exclusion argument rests on
            one attestation row, and the round 1 grep would have archived
            it without the round 2 expanded scan. Worth noting because
            "thin provenance" is the kind of edge case where any future
            tightening of the criterion (e.g., "only path-form counts")
            would re-import this entry to the archive set.
  recommended_change: No change required for this chunk. Future hygiene
                      chunks should make the criterion explicit about
                      whether single-line attestation rows count as
                      load-bearing provenance, or only multi-line
                      citations/path-form references do.

- severity: nit
  category: scope-escape
  section: planning/evidence-hygiene/ARCHIVE-INDEX.md (commit message also)
  claim: "Re-ran the broad reference scan ... plus the D2 production
         inventory; no remaining archived entry is referenced anywhere."
  evidence: My probe of every archive basename against
            evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/r-d2-1-builder-20260814/
            {pre-move-sha256.json, post-move-verification.json} shows
            0 hits for every one of the 14 archived entries. The
            "plus D2 inventory" addendum therefore contributed no
            disqualifying observations. Not incorrect — the claim is
            literally true. But it reads as if the D2 inventory did
            real work on the remaining set; in fact it only matters for
            explaining why r-drs-role-split-2 (zero LEDGER/tests/tools
            hits, but cited by D2 inventory) was NOT archived.
  recommended_change: For future commits of similar shape, either drop
                      the "plus the D2 production inventory" clause when
                      it adds nothing, or call out specifically that
                      the D2 inventory is the reason one zero-hits
                      entry (r-drs-role-split-2) was kept flat.

- severity: nit
  category: scope-escape
  section: evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/r-drs-role-split-2/ (not in archive)
  claim: r-drs-role-split-2 has zero hits under the Check #2 scan but
         was not archived.
  evidence: L=(0,0,0), T=(0,0,0), tools=(0,0,0) for r-drs-role-split-2
            in my independent scan. It is NOT in archive/ at 58c11d3.
            Under strict letter of the brief ("archive anything with
            zero references"), this would be an under-archive. The
            brief explicitly only flags (a) over-archived-with-references
            and (b) over-restored-with-zero-refs as categories worth
            flagging; under-archiving is neither. The decision appears
            intentional ("legacy D2-moved family, leave alone") and is
            consistent with the builder's stated D2-inventory-as-
            cross-check framing.
  recommended_change: No change required. Worth noting for the §10
                      exit-check ceremony that the scope decision is
                      "D2 inventory KEPT this entry flat despite zero
                      LEDGER/tests/tools hits", not "this entry was
                      missed".

- severity: nit
  category: process
  section: 685e379 + 58c11d3 (round 1 origin)
  claim: Round 1 stopped past a self-identified discrepancy
         (23 vs the ~41 from PLAN §1) and added an unsanctioned
         second exclusion source (D2 inventory).
  evidence: Round 1 commit message acknowledges both ("23 archived
            ... 17 referenced by D2 inventory ... Note: the original
            41-entry candidate list ... did not account for D2
            inventory references"). The round 2 fix re-derived the
            exclusion set using the broad 3-form scan and demoted D2
            inventory to supplemental cross-check. Round 2 thus
            addresses the round 1 process violation; this finding is
            recorded for the §9.5 process-distillation record only,
            with no in-flight remediation needed because the round 2
            commit's plan-consistency already corrects the substance.
  recommended_change: Update OPERATING-RULES §18 disambiguation log
                      to note the round 1 / round 2 discrepancy so
                      future rounds recall that "stop and report" was
                      the path the PROMPT-BUILDER prescribes.
```

- `r-chunk1-spec-v2-20260813-2114` restored; LEDGER.md:69 single attestation row is the only LEDGER/test/tool hit, captured by the round 2 fix's broad scan.
- `r-chunk1-code-20260814-0020` restored; L=(8,7,0), heaviest reference set, was the most clearly missed by round 1's grep.
- `r-chunk1-builder-verify-20260814` archived; L=(0,0,0), T=(0,0,0), tools=(0,0,0); "bootstrap probe" reason is descriptive only.
- `r-drs-role-split-2` kept flat; L=(0,0,0), T=(0,0,0), tools=(0,0,0) — let standing because D2 inventory lists its expected destination.

## What I did NOT find

- No referenced entry left in archive (Check #2 invariant holds).
- No content edits outside `ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` (Check #4 invariant holds).
- No `default_evidence_dir`, `tokens/`, or `evidence/LEDGER.md` change (Check #10 invariants hold).
- No fake-green (suite output matches claim, three named test files explicitly pass, not skipped).
- No deletion (every parent blob reachable either at original or under `archive/`).

VERDICT: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS
